notes.title: Playtest build 625
notes.content:
Updates:
- 3d board now scales for higher resolution displays
- certain buttons on the main menu previously could cause
the game to hang. This is no longer the case.
- Game recording added. Games are recorded in standard pgn format,
which can be analyzed with external tools. All your games are recorded (local, ai, and online).

notes.title: Improved menu consistency for mouse&keyboard.
notes.content: As discovered by testers, there were a few menus that couldn't be controlled by either mouse or keyboard. This change fixes those issues and also ensures consistent styling.

notes.title: Playtest build 610: Performance
notes.content:
- Improve fullscreen performance on windows when in the background. Previously this could result in freezing.
- Improved formatting of times < 10 seconds.

notes.title: Playtest build 600 - Multiplayer compatibility with the demo
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I just released the latest playtest build. This contains performance improvements and better support for
high res monitors. Additionally, it has the ability to host games to play against friends that are playing with the free demo version. The demo launched yesterday, so with this change playtesters are able to play against any of their Steam friends!

Have fun! And as always, if you encounter any issues, feel free to reach out to me on Discord.

notes.title: Multiplayer Playtest is live!
notes.content:
The multiplayer playtest is now live! Make sure you update the game to get access.

As always, if you encounter any issues, feel free to DM me directly on Discord, or fill out our bug report form:
